s_steps: AN OLD ROAD CLIMBING ONTO A HIGH PLATEAU: in the south-west low green meadows with heather and groups of dark alpine pines, a dense pine wood filling the valley along the bottom edge; across the middle a long band of sheer GREY ROCK CLIFFS; the pale old road comes in from the west edge, runs east along the foot of the cliffs and turns up through the cliff band on worn stone steps cut into the rock; above, on the plateau, cool silver-green grass with little blue star flowers, and the road runs east past a line of weathered standing marble columns and a fallen column lying in the grass; grey rock ridges close the view along the top. Palette: cool silver greens, mauve heather, slate and dove greys, pale marble, dark blue-green pines. High, airy, ancient, quiet.
s_plateau: THE FLAT TOP OF A HIGH PLATEAU BEFORE A WALLED CITY: cool silver-green grass, patches of mauve heather and little blue star flowers; along the whole top edge the tall pale marble CITY WALL of Orbis with battlements and round towers, pierced in the middle by an open arched gate; in the west-middle a great ancient RING of twelve tall standing marble columns around a round stone altar disc; a small dark pond, a few groups of dark alpine pines; the pale old road comes from the west edge, forks at a crossing: north to the city gate and south-east to the east edge; the plateau ends in grey rock cliffs along the south and west. Palette: silver greens, mauve, pale marble and cream, slate greys, dark pines. Open, windy, solemn, the sky feels near.
s_crater: A GREAT METEOR CRATER ON A HIGH PLATEAU: cool silver-green grass and heather around it; in the middle a deep round crater bowl ringed by a rim of broken grey rock, its inner floor flat dark slate rock with clusters of faceted pale-blue CRYSTALS growing from it and a small ruined stone altar at the very bottom; a footpath leads from the west down a ramp into the crater; the pale road runs from the west edge round the north of the crater to the north edge; grey rock cliffs along the south and east edges; a few dark pines. Palette: silver greens, mauve heather, dark slate, glassy pale blue and white crystals, grey rock. Strange, hushed, glittering.
s_ridge: A NARROW ROCKY RIDGE ABOVE DARK PINE VALLEYS: a long strip of grass and heather running from the south edge to the north, with grey rock cliffs falling away on both sides into dense dark pine forest that fills the rest of the picture; a spur of the ridge reaches out to the west edge; the pale road climbs along the crest from the south edge and meets the road from the west; at the north end stands the base of a tall ROUND TOWER of pale grey stone seen from above (its round roof ringed by a parapet, a small brass dome on top) with its door facing south onto a little paved landing. Palette: silver greens, mauve heather, grey rock, very dark blue-green pines, pale grey stone. Lonely, high, windswept.

_extra.s_plateau: The RING OF COLUMNS is the key landmark: twelve separate round column tops (pale discs with shadows) evenly spaced on an oval around the flat round altar disc; grass between them. The CITY WALL is thick, continuous and straight across the top of the picture, with the gate passage open.
_extra.s_crater: The crater rim is a continuous ring of rock (no gaps) except where the footpath ramp goes down on the west side. The CRYSTALS are small separate clusters exactly where the guide shows them.
_extra.s_ridge: The TOWER is round: draw its round roof exactly over the guide's round block, with the dark door in its south side.
_extra.star_tower_top: The dark red area in the guide is the STAR MAP MOSAIC: paint it as deep blue and dark red tiles with golden stars (flat, walkable), not a carpet.
_extra.star_academy_1: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as stone wall tops, not as rooms.
_extra.star_academy_2: Large grey blocks in the guide are solid WALL MASS (thick masonry of the building seen from above): paint them as stone wall tops, not as rooms.

orbis: A WALLED UNIVERSITY TOWN ON A HIGH PLATEAU AT THE EDGE OF THE SKY: thick pale marble city walls with battlements and round corner towers ring the whole town; an inner wall with two arched gates divides the northern districts from the market; in the north-west the grand white marble ACADEMY with a colonnade and a small dome, beside it a tall library with a copper-green roof, a squat guardroom; in the north-east a round OBSERVATORY with a great bronze dome, a slender star-lamp tower with a glass lantern top, small researchers' houses; in the south the market: pale stone houses and shops with slate-blue roofs, a paved plaza with a round marble star fountain holding a bronze armillary sphere; straight streets of pale flagstones, small lawns, hedges and a few dark trees; arched gates in the south and east walls. Palette: pale marble and cream, slate blues, verdigris, bronze, cool greens. Scholarly, orderly, hushed.
star_academy_1: THE GROUND FLOOR OF A GRAND ACADEMY OF ASTRONOMY seen from above with the roof removed: thick pale stone walls; polished pale marble corridors run in a ring around an open cloister courtyard (a lawn with little blue flowers and a round marble fountain, a low white balustrade around it); four classrooms with dark oak floors, rows of wooden desks and a green blackboard on the north wall; a stair hall in the north with a red carpet and a broad marble staircase going up; an entrance hall in the south with a great barred door; a small service door in the south-west corner. Palette: pale marble, warm oak, deep red, verdigris green blackboards, cool greys. Stately, silent, a little eerie.
star_academy_2: THE UPPER FLOOR OF A GRAND ACADEMY OF ASTRONOMY seen from above with the roof removed: thick pale stone walls; a long marble gallery across the south with the stair landing in its middle; a central marble corridor with a red runner leading north to a heavy iron vault door; the small stone VAULT with iron cabinets and a pedestal with a glass case; in the west the ARCHIVE: a wooden floor with long rows of tall dark bookshelves; in the east the HEADMASTER'S OFFICE with a deep red carpet, a big writing desk, a bookcase and a celestial globe, and a lecture room with rows of wooden benches and a lectern. Palette: pale marble, dark oak, deep red, iron grey, brass. Hushed, secret.
star_tower_1: THE GROUND FLOOR OF AN ANCIENT ROUND TOWER OF STAR READING seen from above with the roof removed: a thick round outer wall of pale grey stone; a pale flagstone floor; an inner round wall with two openings encircles a huge brass ORRERY in the centre (interlocking brass rings, a golden sun sphere and silver planet spheres on a round raised dais); in the north between the walls a small sanctum with a narrow staircase going up; stone pillars round the outer hall; the tower door in the south. Palette: pale grey stone, warm brass and gold, silver, deep blue shadows. Ancient, mechanical, solemn.
star_tower_top: THE FLAT ROOF OF A TALL ROUND TOWER UNDER THE STARS seen from above: a round platform of pale marble ringed by a low stone parapet, beyond it only the deep dark night; in the middle a great round MOSAIC of a star map inlaid in the floor (deep blue and dark red tiles with gold stars and constellation lines); four tall bronze braziers on tripods; in the north a bronze star-reading lectern on a raised round dais with brass sighting arms; in the south the opening of the staircase coming up. Palette: pale marble, deep blue, dark red, gold, bronze, black night. High, silent, sacred.
